title: Write now. Schedule later.
description:

transcript: 5:00 is like right around the corner if you're sending any emails over the holidays before you take that deserved break maybe you just applied to a job and are wanting to follow up write that email today so then you're like mentally checked off from it but then schedule it for like the 1st or 2nd of January so then you've done what you need to do and then that email ends up at the top of the recruiter's inbox do it
